plugins.name: vibesurfer
plugins.description: Headless real browser (WKWebView/WebKitGTK/WebView2) driven over a Unix-socket wire protocol. 20 primitives, state-token concurrency, tree deltas, audit-by-construction. Requires the `vs` binary on PATH (install via `brew tap frane/tap && brew install vibesurfer` or the curl one-liner from the README).
